summary: Apollo Commercial Real Estate Finance, Inc. (ARI) filed an 8-K on June 15, 2026, announcing a special dividend of $3.75/share, mostly return of capital, payable July 15 to holders of record June 30. The board, after a strategic review, determined that dissolution, liquidation, and winding down are advisable and in stockholders' best interest. A preliminary proxy will be filed seeking stockholder approval of a plan of complete liquidation and dissolution, authorizing asset sales and net proceeds distribution. The board retains discretion to terminate or modify the plan or pursue a merger or alternative. Watch for proxy filing details and stockholder vote timeline.
